did.unittitle: Department of Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University, administrative records
did.abstract: The records consist of administrative files documenting the operations of the Department of Manuscripts and Archives at Yale University Library.

corpname.part: Yale University. Department of Manuscripts and Archives

odd.head: General note
odd.p: Forms part of Yale Record Group 32-D (YRG 32-D), Records of Yale school and departmental libraries and collections.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Collecton is restricted to Office of Origin only.

Original born digital files, as well as preservation masters, may not be accessed due to their fragility. Researchers must consult use copies, or if none exist request that they be made. Born digital files cannot be accessed remotely. System requirements include a Manuscripts and Archives computer and file viewing software.
Some records in this finding aid have been redacted, as they include student names, donor names, and other restricted data. These records will not appear in the published finding aid.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Copyright for materials authored or otherwise produced as official business of Yale University is retained by Yale University. Copyright status for other collection materials is unknown. Transmission or reproduction of materials protected by U.S. Copyright Law (Title 17, U.S.C.) beyond that allowed by fair use requires the written permission of the copyright owners. Works not in the public domain cannot be commercially exploited without permission of the copyright owners. Responsibility for any use rests exclusively with the user.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Department of Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University, Administrative Records (RU 129). Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University Library.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Yale University records are arranged and described at the accession level by the creating office. The University Archives creates collection level descriptive records, but typically does no further arrangement and description at the accession level.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The records consist of administrative files documenting the operations of the Department of Manuscripts and Archives at Yale University Library.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The records are arranged by accession.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The Department of Manuscripts and Archvies merged with the Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library in 2022. It no longer exists as an independent unit within the Yale University Library.
